scope: Approximate selection by recorded scheduledOriginUtcApproximate and each observer's UTC timestamps. No verified cross-host clock synchronization; this is not precise distributed alignment or one-way latency. Rates use monotonic deltas on the same host. cgroup/network are shared container observations. CnC counters are sequential, non-atomic reads; registration identity is preserved. Instantaneous position differences are signed observations, not exact queue/replication lag. Archive write-time includes write, configured force and descheduling elapsed time; it is not a pure fsync histogram.
selection: First and last observer samples whose recorded UTC lies within the approximate arrival window. At 1 Hz the delta usually covers window minus about one second; the exact coverage is reported. No interpolation, zero filling, raw evidence modification or live node access.
